mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the eye front and retina was most worthwhile because the finished picture connected focusing, sensing and the route toward the brain.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the iris was clear but fairly predictable after its picture showed an opening that narrows.

surprise.text: I learned that the retina is a curved light-sensitive lining whose nerve fibres gather into the optic nerve.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each pairing a purpose, although the last two choices were the only combinations offered.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: building separate parts and seeing how they work together was satisfying, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
